note: Curated retrieval synonyms: each group is a set of interchangeable search terms linking a lay word to its clinical term or measure, so a plain-language search still finds the clinical record (for example 'diabetes' finding an HbA1c lab). Human-reviewed, never model-generated. These broaden retrieval only; they are never a medical claim, and a wrong entry can at worst surface an unrelated record, never fabricate a fact. Kept conservative: well-established condition, test, and lay-term pairs, no specific drug names. A search only expands when a whole query word exactly matches a term here.
